name: Vercel AI Gateway
note: Quota only, and a balance rather than a meter: the credits endpoint states what is left and never what a full tank was, so there is nothing honest to fill a bar against. The key is read from AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY when Antarium was started from a shell, and from ~/.antarium/keys/vercel-gateway otherwise — an app launched from Finder inherits the launchd session environment rather than a shell's, so the file is the route that always works.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live account.
